narration.text: Still wasting hours on slides when AI can do it in minutes?
At number 5, Gamma. It's great for getting quick drafts done. But if you need to fine-tune every detail, you might find its customisation options a bit limited.
Coming in at number 4, Beautiful.ai. Its smart templates are a lifesaver, ensuring your designs always look consistent and professional. It really takes the guesswork out of good design.
Number 3 is Simplified. This tool can generate entire presentations from just a text prompt. It's incredibly fast, perfect when you need a presentation ready yesterday.
At number 2, we have Tome. It creates interactive, visually stunning presentations with surprising ease. Tome elevates your content, making it truly stand out from the crowd.
And the top spot, number 1, goes to Plus AI. It directly integrates into Google Slides, giving you seamless creation without ever leaving your workspace. It's an absolute game-changer.
Plus AI takes the crown for its direct Google Slides integration. Which AI presentation maker do you use?
